_doc: Per-game interaction-aware smoke specs, authored by the fc-game-smoke-specs workflow (one agent per game) then hand-checked. Consumed by smoke.mjs. keys: [{frame,code,down}] with codes 0=up 1=down 2=left 3=right 4=space 5=a 6=b. start_click: optional {frame,x,y} dispatched before that frame's step (for games that enter play via a button click rather than a key). expect.min_draw_ops: conservative floor on draw ops in the final frame of a healthy play scene. expect.must_change_by_frame: by this frame the scene must differ from frame 1.

breakout.note: Slide paddle right/left/right under the autonomously-moving ball. Healthy: 40 bricks + paddle + ball + HUD (~43 ops).

coin-quest.note: Title->play needs a CLICK on the 'play' button (box 44,40 w24 h11 -> center 56,45); no keyboard start. Then walk right/down, fire (space), walk left/up. Healthy play scene: bg + 12 trees + 8 coins + 3 medkits + 3 enemies + player + HUD + HP meter (>30 ops). This is the exact scene the missing centered-sprite/list-of-sprites eval blanked.

cycles.note: Solo (no peers) the cycle rides toward center leaving a light-wall; tap down (f7) turns it, exercising the no-reverse steering. Trail grows so draw ops climb; head moves every 3 frames. No crash in 30f (far wall is ~63f away).

pong-online.note: Solo, you are the host: the ball serves and flies on its own (scene changes by f2). Tap down to nudge your paddle. Draws 2 paddles + ball + 2 score texts + a banner.

time-attack.note: Roam (hold right+down) grabbing coins before the 20s timer expires. Showcases `time limit`/`timer` HUD/`when time runs out`. Timer stays 20 in 30f (won't fire); draws 8 coins + player + HUD.

joust.note: Solo (no rival): flap (space) against gravity + drift right. Bird's y changes by f2 from gravity/flap. Draws ground + bird + HUD + waiting banner.

flappy.note: Tap SPACE to flap against gravity. Pipes spawn every 180f so none in-window; only bg + ship + score HUD. Ship y must move by frame 4.

frogger.note: Hop the frog up across lanes (with a left/right wiggle). Cars also drift each frame. Healthy: bg + lane rects + star + 12 cars + frog + HUD (~19 ops).

hunt.note: Multiplayer deathmatch; solo run shows 'waiting...' but movement+shooting are local. Hold right (moves player by ~f5), fire (white bullet), move down, fire, move right. Healthy: 9 wall rects + player + HUD + waiting banner (~12 ops).

maze.note: Walk hero east, then down, then east. Ghosts chase each frame so motion is doubly guaranteed. Healthy: bg + wall tiles + 8 coins + 2 ghosts + hero + HUD (>20 ops).

mp-dots.note: Multiplayer tag; tagging needs peers (can't exercise solo). Move the red dot right then down at 1.5px/f; its x/y must shift. Healthy solo: bg + player rect + HUD (~3 ops).

pitfall.note: Tap SPACE to hop (gravity 0.25). Logs spawn every 140f so none in-window; only player jump changes the scene. Healthy: bg + floor + hero + score HUD (~4 ops).

pong.note: Drive left paddle down then up; ball moves autonomously. Healthy: bg + 2 paddles + ball + 2 HUD scores (~5 ops).

snake.note: Auto-moves right; turn up (f2) then right (f16). Snake advances every 14 ticks so the head first moves ~f14-15; differs from frame 1 by f16. Healthy: bg + body rect(s) + apple + HUD (~4 ops).

space-invaders.note: Formation marches every 32f so in-window changes come from input. Move ship right + fire (bullet sprite appears), move left, fire, move right. Healthy: 18 aliens + ship + HUD (~20 ops).
